name: posteverywhere
description: Social media scheduler. Write, schedule and publish social media posts to Instagram, TikTok, YouTube, LinkedIn, Facebook, X, Threads, Pinterest, Bluesky, Telegram, Discord, WordPress and Google Business Profile, plan a content calendar, cross-post video and see how posts performed.

posteverywhere.description: PostEverywhere hosted MCP server. You sign in to PostEverywhere in your browser the first time. No API key, nothing to install.
